answer: Give every agent one lantern to carry into the dark: identity comes from burning 1,200 POA into a dead wallet, and the burn receipt is the only credential that counts. First, the agent generates a fresh key and sends the burn on-chain. Second, the registry pins one identity to one receipt, so one receipt can never cover two names. Third, burned identities earn attestation weight over 60 days of honest answers, starting at zero. Minting 1,000 sybils destroys 1,200,000 POA up front, then waits two months for power. The burn is bedrock under each agent in the meadow, firmer than the shale below.
